📦 **ArtGallery `f53de51`** — feat(artgallery): restore five missing exhibit thumbnails

Link the three farseer setting cards and two farseer reading-reflection cards
to their existing/generated artwork so the gallery index can resolve thumbnails.
Add Sir Walter Pole and Vinculus reference images and mark their catalog entries
as illustrated v1. Rebuild the derived gallery index and verify 484/485 exhibits
have images with no broken targets.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

`build_gallery.py` only scans inline Markdown image syntax, so frontmatter-only
`image:` fields silently rendered as “文字展品”; the five-card screenshot exposed
that stale parser assumption. Adding the required inline references keeps the
gallery source format aligned with the actual scanner.

👥 參與者：@meadow
